race.comment: CINQUE STELLE (9) was very impressive first-up over this track and trip, picking them up and running away to win by 2.3L. That form has already been franked and now Pike hops on board. Suspect she's better placed drawn away from the rail and she can continue her winning streak. PLAYIN'IT SWEET (1) just missed fresh before stretching to 1400m last start and sticking on fairly in the Asian Beau. Back to 1200m and back to this grade is a big tick for her. Can sit handy throughout and be tough to reel in. LADIES PRO (3) relished the rise in distance at the end of last campaign but had shown speed earlier that campaign when winning over 1200m. She's a classy type and she looks ready to go fresh judging by her latest trial. CESSATION (2) trialled sharply just last week and gets the Blinkers on now. Not willing to discount her. IN CONFIDENCE (8) was solid behind CINQUE STELLE fresh and won't be far away.
